records.summary: 37 tests over the generator, which found and fixed a live crash: a null summary in any repository's metadata took the whole site build down with a TypeError. CI on three Python versions plus a job that rebuilds the real page from the checked-in snapshot and validates the feed, sitemap and JSON-LD.

verifications.note: 37 new tests over the generator, run locally before the push
the real 27-project snapshot still renders: 27 cards, JSON-LD parses

records.summary: A routing gate the roster did not have: with 70 agents nothing stopped two of them claiming the same trigger phrase, so the user could say the right sentence and get the wrong agent with every file still passing. It found two real collisions, both fixed. Plus the one bug class no agent owned: date and time, with the Turkey-specific stale-tzdata trap.

verifications.note: new gate: 71 agents, 273 trigger phrases, 0 exact collisions after the two it found were fixed
the gate's own 19 checks, including that the real roster passes
71/71 through field validation and the boundary contract, with the new agent
all four export targets in sync at 71 agents
the dogrula workflow succeeded on the pushed commit with the two new steps in it

records.summary: Wiring the Action into four games found a bug in it in under a minute, and the wrong way round: it read its counts out of prose a clean project never prints, so it failed on exactly the repositories that were fine. Counts now come from --json, and a new gate runs the action's own shell across clean and broken fixtures at every fail-on level.

verifications.note: new gate: 6 cases across clean and broken fixtures at every fail-on level, running the action's own shell with the runner's flags
the same gate against the old action.yml fails on the first three cases, which is the regression it exists to catch
